implementation: ACodeRescueCharacter::GetWeaponQuickSlotSummary feeds UCodeRescueHUDWidget::WeaponStripText with 1-0 key labels, active marker, compact names, and magazine plus reserve ammo.
player_contract: Player can see the active weapon and the full 1-0 quick-slot row without opening a menu.

implementation: UCodeRescueGameInstance captures ActiveWeapon, WeaponMagazines, and WeaponReserveAmmo into UCodeRescueSaveGame when writing the active language slot.
player_contract: Weapon selection and per-slot ammo progression persist with the chosen coding-language run.

implementation: UCodeRescueGameInstance restores saved weapon quick-slot state after health/resources are restored.
player_contract: Relaunching or loading a language save keeps the same active weapon and magazine/reserve state.

implementation: SpawnTacticalArmoryLayer adds a QUICK SLOT BOARD plus KEY 1 through KEY 0 labels for the first ten weapons and WHEEL labels for extended arsenal weapons.
player_contract: The armory teaches immediate gear selection before combat starts, and the HUD mirrors the same key order.

implementation: UCodeRescueSaveGame uses bHasWeaponQuickSlotState so older saves fall back to default loadout behavior.
player_contract: Older saves still load while newer saves preserve richer weapon state.
